headline: Tech Mahindra and L&T Finance report 33% profit growth; SEBI revises derivative settlement rules

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Tech Mahindra reported a significant 33% jump in its Q2 net profit
L&T Finance saw its Q2 net profit rise by 33% to Rs 975 crore
SEBI announced a new last 30-minute VWAP method for derivative settlement
Persistent Systems reported a 25.4% decline in Q2 profit despite revenue growth
whatHappening: IT and financial sectors are showing mixed Q2 results with strong gains for Tech Mahindra and L&T Finance
SEBI is implementing major changes to CAS timings and derivative expiry settlement rules effective December 7
Jio is focusing on technology monetisation and aiming for debt-free status
AstraZeneca has entered a $40 million AI-driven drug discovery partnership
summary: Tech Mahindra and L&T Finance led market sentiment with robust 33% profit growth in their second-quarter results. SEBI introduced significant regulatory updates to derivative settlements and CAS timings to be implemented this December. Persistent Systems faced pressure following a 25.4% drop in quarterly net profit.
